Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1001252": The catalog service relies on the resizer.  (about: catalog service, the resizer)
- memory_id "1001140": On 2026-03-20, the Boreal team observed that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Boreal team, catalog service)
